English: The quality of aggregates affects the durability and performance of pavement as it is the dominant component both in rigid and flexible pavement.
Luganda: Omutindo gw’obuyinja gukosa obuwangaazi n’enkola ya kkoolaasi kubanga ky’ekintu ekisinga Okukozesebwa mu kukuba kkoolaasi.

Zulu: Izinga lohlwayi lithinta ukuqina nokusebenza konqenqema njengoba iyisici esivelele kukho kokubili ku-pavement eqinile futhi eguquguqukayo.
Hausa: Ingancin abubuwan tarawa yana shafar ɗorewa da ƙarfin aikin makarin hanya saboda shi ne babban abin da ke cikin tafarki mai tsayi da sassauƙan makarin hanya.
Northern Sotho: Boleng bja makgwara bo na le seabe go kgotlelelo le go kgwahla ga tselathokwana ka ge e le karolo ye bohlokwa go tselathokwana ye e kgwahlilego le ye e thepheselago.
Amharic: የአሃዶች ጥራት የመንገድ ዳር ንጣፍ ዘላቂነት እና አሰራር ላይ ተጽእኖ ያደርጋሉ፤ ይህም የሆነው የጠንካራም ሆነ የተጣጣፊ የመንገድ ዳር ንጣፍ ዋና ክፍለ አካላት ስልሆኑ ነው።

English: Hence, aggregate quality assessment is important to ensure the good performance of aggregate in different sections of pavements.

Yoruba: Fún ìdí èyí, ó ṣe pàtàkì láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò àwọn iye ohun-èlò-aṣekọnkéré láti ri dájú pé ohun-èlò-kọnkéré nínú ìpele pèpele kọ̀ọ̀kan so èso rere.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlolwa kweqophelo okuhlanganisiwe kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kohlwayi ezigabeni ezahlukene zonqenqema.
Hausa: Domin haka, jimlar ingancin ƙima yana da mahimmanci don tabbatar da kyakkyawan aiki na jimlar a sassa daban-daban na abin kare hanya.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona, tekolo ya boleng bja lekgwara e bohlokwa go kgonthiša go šoma gabotse ga lekgwara go dikarolo tša go fapafapana tša ditselathokwana.
Amharic: ስለዚህ የአሃድ የጥራት ግምገማ በተለያዩ የመንገድ ዳር ንጣፍ ክፍሎች የአሃዱን ጥሩ ተግባራዊነት ለማረጋገጥ አስፈላጊ ነው።

English: The present work aims to assess the suitability of limestone for road aggregate.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kuluubirira kwekaliriza butuukire bw’olwazi lw’ennoni mu kufunamu obuyinja obukozesebwa mu kuzimba enguudo.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ yìí dálé yíyẹ ìbámu òkúta-ẹfun wò fún àwọn ohun-èlò-aṣekọnkéré ọ̀nà.
Zulu: Umsebenzi wamanje uhlose ukuhlola ukufaneleka komc ekuhlanganisweni komgwaqo.
Hausa: Aikin na yanzu yana nufin tantance dacewa da dutsen farar ƙasa domin kayan gina hanya.
Northern Sotho: Mošomo wa bjale o nepile go lekola go ba le maswanedi ga kalaka go lekgwara la tseleng.
Amharic: የአሁኑ ስራ የኖራ ድንጋይ ለመንገድ አሃድነት ተስማሚ እንደሆነ ለማሰስ ያቅዳል።

English: Thirty-seven Mesozoic limestone samples obtained from previously identified suitable quarry sites were subjected to petrographic and geotechnical analyses.
Luganda: Sampolo amakumi asatu mu musanvu ez’obuyinja bw’ennoni ezaafunibwa okuva mu birombe by’amayinja ebyazuulwa gye buvuddeko zeekalirizibwa n’ekyuma ekizimbulukusa.
Yoruba: Àwọn àgbéyẹ̀wò ajẹmọ́-àpèjúwe-àpáta àti ìmọ̀-ajẹmọ-ohun-èlò-ayé ní wọ́n gbé àpẹẹrẹ òkúta-ẹfun métàdílógójì tí wọ́n rí gbà láti kùsà tí wọ́n rí tẹ́lẹ̀ rí lé.
Zulu: Amasampula ohlwayi lomcaka angamashumi amathathu nesikhombisa atholwe ezindaweni zenkwali ezihlonzwe ngaphambilini aye ahlolwa ngokocwaningomatshe kanye ne-geotechnical.
Hausa: An gudanar da samfurori talatin da bakwai na dutsen farar ƙasa na Mesozoic da aka samo daga wuraren da suka dace da wuraren da aka gano a baya da binciken petrographic da kuma geotechnical.
Northern Sotho: Disampole tša kalaka ya Mesozoic tše masometharošupa tše di tšerwego mafelong ao a hlaotšwego peleng a khwari ya makgonthe a ile a lebanwa le tshekatsheko ya petrokerafiki le tšeotheknikhale.
Amharic: ሰላሳ-ሰባት ከዛሬ በፊት ተለይተው ከወጡ ተስማሚ የድንጋይ ማውጫ ቦታዎች የተወሰዱ የሜሶዞይክ የኖራ ድንጋይ ናሙናዎች ፔትሮግራፊክ እና ጂኦቴክኒካል ትንተና ተደርጎባቸዋል።

English: Physical properties (ultrasonic pulse velocity (PVU), water absorption (Wa), Na2SO4 soundness, and specific gravity tests) and mechanical properties (unconfined compressive strength (UCS), Aggregate crushing value (ACV), Aggregate Impact Value (AIV), and Los Angles Abrasion value (LAAV)) were determined in the lab and then compared with the globally accepted standards.
Luganda: Enkalira ezirabwako (ultrasonic pulse velocity (PVU), okufuna amazzi (Wa), obungi bw’ekirungo kya Na2SO4, n’okukebera ebirungo ebirala eby’enjawulo) n’enkalira ezeekuusa ku bugumu (unconfined compressive strength (UCS), omuwendo gw’obuyinja obutayatika nga buteereddwako ebintu ebizito (ACV), obugugubi bw’obuyinja eri ebyekango (AIV), n’omuwendo gwa Los Angeles ogupima obugumu bw’obuyinja (LAAV)) zaafunibwa mu kkeberero n’oluvannyuma ne zigeraageranyizibwa n’omutindo ogukkirizibwa mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn èròjà sáyẹ́nsì ( mímọ òdiwọ̀n okun àpáta PUV), gbígbà omi (WA), kẹ́míkà Na2SO4, àti èrònjà mẹkáníkà pẹ̀lú àyẹ̀wò òdiwọ̀n èrònjà sáyẹ́nsì (àyèwò ìdiwọ̀n okun tí ilẹ̀ ni láti kojú ọ̀gbàrá (UCS), Aṣàtakò Fífún Ohun-èlò-aṣekọnkéré (ACV), Aṣàtakò Ipa Ẹrù (AIV), àti Mímọ̀ òṣùwọ̀n agbára àti ìpalára (LAAV) ni wọ́n wò ní láábù tí wọ́n sì ṣẹ àfiwéra wọ́n pẹ̀lú ohun tí ó jẹ́ ìtẹ́wọ́gbà káàkiri àgbáyé.
Zulu: Izakhiwo zomzimba (i-ultrasonic pulse velocity (PVU), ukumuncwa kwamanzi (Wa), umsindo we-Na2SO4, nokuhlolwa okuthile kwamandla adonsela phansi) kanye nezakhiwo zemishini (amandla acindezelayo anganqunyelwe (UCS), inani lokuchoboza elihlanganisiwe (ACV), Inani Lomthelela wohlwayi (AIV), kanye I-Los Angles Abrasion value (LAAV)) yanqunywa elebhu yase iqhathaniswa namazinga amukelwa emhlabeni wonke.
Hausa: An gano Kadarorin jiki (Vlocity pulse ultrasonic (PVU), shan ruwa (Wa), sautin Na2SO4, da takamaiman gwaje-gwajen nauyi) da kadarorin na’ura (ƙarfin matsawa mara iyaka (UCS), Ƙimar murƙushewa (ACV), Ƙimar Tasiri (AIV), da Ƙimar Los Angles Abrasion (LAAV)) a cikin ɗakin gwaje-gwaje sannan idan aka kwatanta da ƙa'idojin da aka yarda da su a duniya.
Northern Sotho: Dibopego tše di ka lemogwago (ultrasonic pulse velocity (PVU), nwelelo ya meetse (Wa), go ba le modumo wa Na2SO4, le diteko tša boima bjo itšego) le dibopego tša mekhenikhale (unconfined compressive strength (UCS), Boleng bja go šila lekgwara (ACV), Boleng bja Teteano ya Lekgwara (AIV), le Los Angles Abrasion value (LAAV)) di laetšwa ka laporathoring gomme tša bapetšwa le maemo ao a amogelwago lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: ቁሳዊ ባህሪያት (አልትራሶኒክ የፐልስ ፍጥነት (PVU)፣ የውሃ እርገት (Wa)፣ የNa2SO4 አመቺነት እና የተወሰኑ የመሬት ስበት ሙከራዎች) እና ሜካኒካዊ ባህሪያት (ያልተገደበ የማመቅ ጥንካሬ (ያ.ማ.ጥ)፣ የአሃድ የመጨፍለቅ ዋጋ (አ.መ.ዋ) የአሃድ የግጭት ዋጋ (አ.ግ.ዋ) እና የሎስአንጀለስ የጭረት ዋጋ (LAAV)) በላብራቶሪ ውስጥ የተገኙ ሲሆን በመቀጠል በአለም ዙሪያ ተቀባይነት ካላቸው ደረጃዎች ጋር ተወዳድረዋል።

English: The petrographic observations revealed that the Mesozoic limestones of the area are dominantly composed of micrite, sparite, and bioclasts with subordinate intraclasts, ooids, Fe-oxides, and dolomites.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza olwazi kwalaga ng’obuyinja bw’ennoni obw’emirembe emidayinaso obuli mu kitundu businga kubeeramu kirungo kya mayikulayiti, siparayiti, obupapajjo bw’ebimera obulimu intraclasts, ooids, Fe-oxides, ne dolomayiti.
Yoruba: Ìwòye ajẹmọ́-àpèjúwe-àpáta fihàn pé òkúta-ẹfun ọlọdún pípẹ́ tó wà ní agbègbè náà jẹ́ àkójọpọ̀ micrite, sparite,àti bioclasts pèlú intraclast ooids, Fe-oxides, àti àwọn dolomite.
Zulu: Ukubheka ngokocwaningomathse kwembula ukuthi ama-inkwali yomcaka esendaweni eyakhiwe ngokuyinhloko ama-mikhirayithi, i-sparayithi, nama-bhayoklasst anama-intraclasts angaphansi, i-ooids, i-Fe-oxides, nama-dolomite.
Hausa: Binciken petrographic ya nuna cewa dutsen farar ƙasa na Mesozoic na yankin sun kasance mafi rinjaye na micrite, sparite, da bioclasts tare da ƙananan intraclasts, ooids, Fe-oxides, da dolomites.
Northern Sotho: Ditemogo tša petrokerafiki di utollotše gore dikalaka tša Mesozoic tša tikologo di bopša kudu ke micrite, sparite, le bioclasts ka intraclasts, ooids, Fe-oxides, le dolomites tša ka fasana.
Amharic: የፔትሮግራፊክ ምልከታው እንዳሳየው በአካባቢው ያሉት የሜሶዞይክ የኖራ ድንጋዮች በዋነኛነት የተሰሩት ከሚስራይት፣ ስፓራይት እና ባዮክላስቶች ሲሆን በንኡስ ደረጃ ደግሞ በኢንትራክላስቶች፣ ኦኦይዶች፣ Fe-ኦክሳይዶች እና ዶሎማይቶች ነው።

English: Results of the physical properties show the rock has a mean PVU of 4859 m/s, a bulk dry specific gravity (Gsb) of 2.64, and very low water absorption capacity ranging from 0.2-5.7%, and Na2SO4 soundness ranging from 1-14%.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa okuva mu bintu ebirabwako ebyekalirizibwa biraga nti olwazi lulina omukkati gwa PVU gwa 4859 m/s, obuzito bw’obuyinja (Gsb) bwa 2.64, ennyingiza y’amazzi eri wansi nnyo ku kigero kya 0.2-5.7%, n’obungi bwa Na2SO4 obw’ekigero ekiva ku 1-14%.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì àwọn èrònjà sáyẹ́nsì ti fihàn pé àpáta náà ni PVU ti 4859 m/s, àyẹwò òdiwọn sáyẹ́nsì (Gsb) jẹ́ 2.64, àti gbígbà omi tí ó kéré gan-an bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti 0.2-5.7%, àti Na2SO4 bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti 1-14%.
Zulu: Imiphumela yezakhiwo ezibonakalayo ibonisa ukuthi idwala linesilinganiso se-PVU esingu-4859 m/s, amandla adonsela phansi omile ngobuningi (Gsb) angu-2.64, namandla okumunca amanzi aphansi kakhulu asuka ku-0.2-5.7%, kanye nomsindo we-Na2SO4 osuka ku-1-14 %.
Hausa: Sakamako na kadarorin jiki sun nuna dutsen yana da matsakaicin PVU na 4859 m/s, babban busasshen takamaiman nauyi (Gsb) na 2.64, da ƙarancin shan ruwa daga 0.2-5.7%, da sautin Na2SO4 daga 1-14 %.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša dibopego tše di ka lemogwago di bontšha gore leswika le na le PVU ya magareng ya 4859 m/s, e lego boima bjo itšego bja go oma ga leraga (Gsb) bja 2.64, le kelo ya fase kudu ya go nwelela ga meetse go tloga go 0.2-5.7%, le go ba le modumo wa Na2SO4 wa go tloga go 1-14%.
Amharic: የቁሳዊ ባህሪያት ውጤቶች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ ድንጋዩ አማካይ 4859 ሜ/ሰ PVU አለው፣ 2.64 የጅምላ ደረቅ የተወሰነ የመሬት ስበት (Gsb) ፣ ከ 0.2-5.7%፣ የሚደርስ እጅግ ዝቅተኛ የውሃ እርገት አቅም እና ከ1-14% የሚደርስ የNa2SO4 ልከኛነት አለው።

English: UCS, AIV, ACV, and LAAV range from 20.5-180.5Mpa, 8-20%, 24-34%, and 18.9-31.1%, respectively.
Luganda: UCS eva ku 20.5-180.5Mpa, AIV okuva ku 8-20%, ACV okuva ku 24-34%, ne LAAV n’eva ku 18.9-31.1% mu nziriŋŋana eyo.
Yoruba: UCS, AIV, ACV, àti LAAV bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti 20.5-180.5Mpa, 8-20%, 24-34%, àti 18.9-31.1%, lọ́kọ́ọ̀kan.
Zulu: I-UCS, AIV, ACV, ne-LAAV ibanga ukusuka ku-20.5-180.5Mpa, 8-20%, 24-34%, kanye no-18.9-31.1%, ngokulandelana.
Hausa: UCS, AIV, ACV, da LAAV sun bambanta daga 20.5-180.5Mpa, 8-20%, 24-34%, da 18.9-31.1%, bi-da-bi.
Northern Sotho: UCS, AIV, ACV, le LAAV di tloga go 20.5-180.5Mpa, 8-20%, 24-34%, le 18.9-31.1%, ka go latelana.
Amharic: በቅደም ተከተል፣ ያ.ማ.ጥ፣ አ.ግ.ዋ፣ አ.መ.ዋ እና LAAV ከ20.5-180.5Mpa፣ 8-20%፣ 24-34%፣ ወደ 18.9-31.1% ይደርሳል።

English: The physical, chemical and mechanical properties of the entire limestones sample comply with the required standards, suggesting their suitability as aggregate materials in road construction.
Luganda: Enkalira ezirabwako, ezeekuusa ku birungo n’obugumu bwa sampolo z’obuyinja bw’ennoni zonna zituukana n’omutindo ogwetaagisa, ne kitegeeza nti zisaanidde okukozesebwa ng’obuyinja obukozesebwa mu kuzimba enguudo.
Yoruba: Àwọn èròǹjà ara, kẹ́míkà àti mẹkáníkà ti ara òkúta-ẹfun tí wọ́n fi ṣe àyèwò kójúìwọn, èyí fihàn pé àwọn ohun-èlò-aṣekọnkéré náà dára fún ṣíse ọ̀nà.
Zulu: Izakhiwo ezingokoqobo, zamakhemikhali nezomshini zawo wonke amasampula enkwali zihambisana namazinga adingekayo, okuphakamisa ukufaneleka kwazo njengezinto ezihlanganisiwe ekwakhiweni komgwaqo.
Hausa: Abubuwan da ake amfani da su na zahiri, sinadarai da injina na dukkan samfuran dutsen farar ƙasa sun bi ƙa'idojin da ake buƙata, suna bayar da shawarar dacewarsu a matsayin jimillar kayan aikin ginin hanya.

English: These tests allowed them to see whether the limestone met the basic requirements to be used as an aggregate according to international standards.
Luganda: Okugezeza kuno kwabasobozesa okulaba oba ng’ennoni etuukana n’ebisaanyizo ebikulu ebyetaagibwa okusobola okukozesebwa ng’obuyinja okusinziira ku mutindo gw’ensi yonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn àyẹ̀wò yìí jẹ́ kí wọ́n mọ̀ bóyà àwọn òkúta-ẹfun yìí ní àwọn àmúyẹ tó nílò láti wà lára ohun-èlò-aṣekọnkéré gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìgbékalẹ̀ gbogboògbò.
Zulu: Lokhu kuhlola kwabavumela ukuthi babone ukuthi inkwali iyahlangabezana yini nezidingo eziyisisekelo okufanele zisetshenziswe njengeqoqo ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso zamazwe ngamazwe.
Hausa: Waɗannan gwaje-gwajen sun ba su damar ganin ko dutsen farar ƙasa ya cika ainihin buƙatun da za a yi amfani da shi a zaman jimillar ƙa’idodin ƙasa-da-ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tše di ba thušitše go lemoga ge e ba kalaka e fihleletše dinyakwa tša motheo tša go ka šomišwa bjalo ka lekgwara go ya ka dinyakwa tša boditšhabatšhaba.
Amharic: እነዚህ ምርመራዎች የኖራ ድንጋዩ አለም አቀፍ የአሃዶች የደረጃ መሰረታዊ መስፈርቶችን ያሟላ እንደሆነ ለማየት አስችሏቸዋል።

English: They found that the samples passed most of these tests easily, and that the limestone could be used to build strong and durable roads.
Luganda: Baazuula nga sampolo zino ziyise okugezesebwa kuno okusinga mu bwangu, era ne kiba nga ennoni esobola okukozesebwa okuzimba enguudo eŋŋumu era empangaazi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i pé àwọn àpẹẹrẹ náà kógojá nínú àwọn àyèwò náà, àti pé òkúta-ẹfun náà ṣé e lò láti kọ́ ọnà tó lé dáadáa tó sì ma pẹ́.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi amasampula aphumelele iningi lalezi zivivinyo kalula, nokuthi inkwali yayingasetshenziswa ukwakha imigwaqo eqinile neqinile.
Hausa: Sun kuma gano cewa samfuran sun wuce mafi yawan waɗannan gwaje-gwaje cikin sauƙi, kuma ana iya amfani da dutsen farar ƙasa don gina hanyoyi masu ƙarfi da kuma ɗorewa.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore disampole di atlegile gabonolo go bontši bja diteko tše, le gore kalaka e ka šomišwa go aga ditsela tša go kgwahla le tše kgotlelelago.
Amharic: ናሙናዎቹ እነዚህን ፈተናዎች በቀላሉ እንዳለፉ ያገኙ ሲሆን፣ የኖራ ድንጋዩ ጠንካራ እና ዘላቂ መንገዶችን ለመገንባት ጥቅም ላይ መዋል እንደሚችል አግኝተዋል።

English: They also found that their samples didn’t absorb a lot of water, which means they will last longer.
Luganda: Baayongera era ne bazuula nga sampolo zaabwe tezaayingiza mazzi mangi, ekitegeeza nti zijja kuwangaala.
Yoruba: Bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ní wọ́n ri pé àwọn àpẹẹrẹ yìí kọ̀ gba omi jù, èyí túmọ̀ sí pé wọ́n máa pẹ́ dáadáa.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi amasampula abo awamuncanga amanzi amaningi, okusho ukuthi azohlala isikhathi eside.
Hausa: Sun kuma gano cewa samfuransu ba su sha ruwa mai yawa ba, wanda hakan yake nufin za su daɗe.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše le gore disampole tša bona ga se tša nwelela meetse a mantši, seo se šupago gore di tla kgotlelela nako ye telele.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ናሙናዎቻቸው ብዙ ውሃ እነዳላሰረጉ ያገኙ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ማለት ለረጅም ጊዜ መቆየት ይችላሉ።

English: They added that although there were some differences between the samples, there was only one sample that didn’t meet the requirements.
Luganda: Baayongerako ne bagamba nti newankubadde nga waaliwokko enjawulo mu sampolo ez’enjawulo, sampolo emu yokka y’etaatuukiriza bisaanyizo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi kun pé bo tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ìyàtọ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan wà nínú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ náà, àpẹẹrẹ kan ni kò ní àmúyẹ tó péye.
Zulu: Bangeza ngokuthi nakuba kunomehluko phakathi kwamasampula, kunesampula eyodwa kuphela engazange ihlangabezane nezidingo.
Hausa: Sun kuma ƙara da cewa ko da yake akwai wasu bambance-bambance a tsakanin samfuran, akwai samfurin ɗaya kawai da bai cika ƙa’idojin ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba tlaleleditše ka gore le ge go be go na le go fapafapana magareng ga disampole, go bile le sampole e tee fela yeo e bego e sa fihlelele dinyakwa.
Amharic: በናሙናዎቹ መሃል ልዩነቶች ቢኖሩም መስፈርቶቹን ማሟላት ግን ያልቻለው አንድ ናሙና ብቻ እንደሆነ አክለው ተናግረዋል።

English: The scientists said that this is the first time the specific type of limestone they used, called Mesozoic limestone, has been tested as an aggregate for road construction.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi baagamba nti guno gwe mulundi ogusoose okugezesa ekika ky’ennoni kye baakozesa, ekiyitibwa ennoni eya Mesozoic, ng’obuyinja obukozesebwamu kuzimba enguudo.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì sọ pé, àkọ́kọ́ ní èyí tí wọ́n yóò ṣẹ àyèwò lórí irúfẹ́ òkúta-ẹfun yìí tí wọ́n pè ní òkúta-ẹfun ìgbà Mesosóíkì gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun-èlò asekọnkéré fún ọ̀nà ṣíṣe.
Zulu: Ososayensi bathi kungokokuqala ngqa ukuthi kuhlolwe uhlobo oluthile lwenkwali abalusebenzisayo, olubizwa ngenkwali yomcaka, njengenhlanganisela yokwakhiwa komgwaqo.
Hausa: Masana kimiyyar sun ce wannan shi ne karo na farko da aka gwada takamaiman nau’in dutsen da suka yi amfani da shi, mai suna Mesozoic limestone, a matsayin jimillar ginin hanya.
Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di boletše gore ke lekga la mathomo mohuta wo wa kalaka ya go ikgetha wo ba o šomišitšego, wo o bitšwago kalaka ya Mesozoic, o dirwa diteko bjalo ka lekgwara leo le ka šomišwago kagong ya ditsela.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶቹ ሜሶዞይክ የተሰኘውን የተለየ የኖራ ድንጋይ አይነት ለመንገድ ግንባታ አሃድነት ስንፈትሽ የመጀመሪያ ጊዜያችን ነው ብለዋል።

English: Their results show that Ethiopian limestone can be used during different stages of the road-building process, as part of both the lower and surface layers of roads.
Luganda: Bye baazuula biraga nti ennoni ey’e Ethiopia asobola okukozesebwa mu mitendera egy’enjawulo egiyitibwamu mu kuzimba oluguudo, ku mwaliriro gw’oluguudo ogwa wansi n’omwaliriro ogw’okungulu.
Yoruba: Àbájáde èsì fihàn pé wọ́n lè lo òkúta-ẹfun ti Ethiopian ní oríṣìíríṣìí ìpele ọ̀nà ṣíṣẹ, ó lè wà lára pèle ìsàlè àti tí òkè àwọn ọ̀nà.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo ikhombisa ukuthi inkwali yase-Ethiopia ingasetshenziswa ezigabeni ezehlukene zenqubo yokwakhiwa komgwaqo, njengengxenye yazo zombili izingqimba ezingaphansi nezingaphezulu zemigwaqo.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa ana iya amfani da dutsen farar ƙasa na ƙasar Habasha a lokacin matakai daban-daban na aikin gina titunan, a matsayin wani ɓangare na ƙasa da kuma saman tituna.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laetša gore kalaka ya Ethiopia e ka šomišwa magatong ao a fapafapanego a mošomo wa go aga ditsela, bjalo ka karolo ya go alwa ka fase le ka godimo go ditsela.
Amharic: ውጤቶቻቸው እንደሚያሳዩት የኢትዮጵያ ኖራ ድንጋይ መንገድ በመገንባት ሂደት ውስጥ ባሉ የተለያዩ ደረጃዎች እንደ መንገዱ የታችኛው ክፍል እና እንደመንገዱ ወለል ንብርብር ጥቅም ላይ መዋል ይችላል።

English: The work was done by scientists from Ethiopia and adds to what we know about how to use  limestone as a material in different types of construction.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa bannassaayansi okuva mu ggwanga lya Ethiopia era nga kwongera ku ebyo bye tumanyi ku ngeri y’okukozesaamu ennoni ng’ekikozesebwa mu nzimba ez’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì láti Ethiopia ní wọ́n ṣẹ ìwádìí yìí àti wí pé wọ́n fikún ohun tí a mọ̀ nípa bí wọ́n ṣe ń lo òkúta-ẹfun gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun-èlò fún orísìíríṣìí ọ̀nà.
Zulu: Umsebenzi wenziwa ososayensi base-Ethiopia futhi wengeza kulokho esikwaziyo mayelana nendlela yokusebenzisa inkwali njengesakhi ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zokwakha.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya ne daga ƙasar Habasha suka yi aikin kuma ya ƙara da abin da muka sani game da yadda ake amfani da farar ƙasa a matsayin wani abu a cikin nau’o’in gini daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Mošomo o dirilwe ke ditsebi tša mahlale go tšwa Ethiopia gomme o tlaleletša go seo re se tsebago mabapi le ka moo go ka šomišwago kalaka bjalo ka sedirišwa go mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya tša boagi.
Amharic: ስራው ከኢትዮጵያ በመጡ ሳይንቲስቶች የተሰራ ሲሆን የኖራ ድንጋይን በተለያዩ የግንባታ አይነቶች ላይ ስለመጠቀም የምናውቀው እውቀት ላይ ጨምሯል።
